subject: Geografia
description_pt: Elaborar e interpretar gráficos de barras e de setores, mapas temáticos e esquemáticos (croquis) e anamorfoses geográficas para analisar, sintetizar e apresentar dados e informações sobre diversidade, diferenças e desigualdades sociopolíticas e geopolíticas mundiais.

components.description_pt: Construir gráficos de barras e gráficos de pizza para representar dados sociopolíticos e geopolíticos
components.description_en: Construct bar graphs and pie charts to represent sociopolitical and geopolitical data
components.cc_component_description: Represent a given dataset in an appropriate graphical display such as a bar graph, pictograph, or pie chart

components.description_pt: Construir mapas temáticos e cartogramas para representar dados de diversidade global e desigualdade
components.description_en: Construct thematic maps and cartograms to represent global diversity and inequality data

components.description_pt: Interpretar mapas esboçados e cartogramas representando padrões sociopolíticos e geopolíticos mundiais
components.description_en: Interpret sketch maps and cartograms representing sociopolitical and geopolitical patterns worldwide
components.cc_component_description: Interpret graphical displays such as maps, charts, and tables to extract patterns from large data sets

components.description_pt: Sintetizar dados geográficos de múltiplas representações gráficas para analisar desigualdades globais
components.description_en: Synthesize geographic data from multiple graphic representations to analyze global inequalities
components.cc_component_description: Synthesize qualitative and quantitative information from multiple formats to strengthen scientific arguments

cc_matches.description: Represent data in tables and/or various graphical displays (bar graphs, pictographs, and/or pie charts) to reveal patterns that indicate relationships.
Use graphical displays (e.g., maps, charts, graphs, and/or tables) of large data sets to identify temporal and spatial relationships.
Integrate qualitative and/or quantitative scientific and/or technical information in written text with that contained in media and visual displays to clarify claims and findings.
